[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==

The same 1911 Gortereghy browse lists two further Elder households not currently represented in the catalogue: Joseph Elder, aged 79, with Ellen Elder, aged 38, recorded as his niece, and William Elder, aged 40, with Elizabeth Elder, aged 50, recorded as his sister. This demonstrates that Gortereghy contained several distinct Elder households at the same time.<ref>1911 Gortereghy, Joseph Elder household; https://api-census.nationalarchives.ie/census/image/nai001390154.pdf; Form A; official index/printed house 36; rows 1–2; 1911 Gortereghy, William Elder household; https://api-census.nationalarchives.ie/census/image/nai001390136.pdf; Form A; official index house 27; rows 1–2. Original register or Form A inspected on 30 September 2026; source-specific image and entry references supplied. Profile identities and cross-record continuity remain qualified where stated.</ref>

== Research Notes ==

Identity revalidation, 17 October 2026: No supported separate Ellen profile was identified for Joseph's niece aged 38 in 1911. Local Elder-7143 represents Ellen Jane (1823–1879), rather than this younger woman. Global near-age Elder-6578 belongs to a Utah family as a daughter of Claybourne and Mary Pratt, with a different family and locality.
